admission.justification: Only the bad-input, drift and four-label tests distinguish a writer that drops the effect or borrows a member revision from one that stores the family's own revision with the authored label.

applicability: Every curator hand-off that names a family in history on converted memory
conditions: The named family record exists in the candidate
Disposition changed carries an effect; rerouted, assigned, no_impact and retired carry none
exclusions: Frozen files, which the writer never rewrites
Curator-supplied revisions, which are never accepted

evidence: 224-test final-byte closure: bad input/no-write, nonchanged dispositions, revision6→7 vs member1; all-four-label CLI/parsed-document proof.

statement: The writer records the candidate family's actual own revision and the supplied existing effect label, refusing invalid or curator-owned mechanical input before writing.
